icons.name: partly-cloudy
icons.heading: Partly cloudy
icons.description: The sun breaks through the cloud. Light: a wave of light sweeps clockwise from the lowest ray toward the cloud: each ray pulls back into the disc and shines out again in turn while the disc swells once; as the last rays reach the cloud it is pushed aside, away from the sun, and drifts back with one small rebound.
